fields.description: Palace Residences Creek Blue brings one to three bedroom apartments to Dubai Creek Harbour, near Creek Beach. The Palace-branded development pairs private balconies and generous glazing with a landscaped leisure podium. Its published plans include ground-floor homes with larger outdoor areas as well as apartments higher in the tower.

research.community: Dubai Creek Harbour · near Creek Beach
overview: The brochure describes contemporary kitchens and living spaces opening onto private balconies. A glazed fitness pavilion overlooks the pools, while the landscaped podium connects towards the waterfront promenade. Parking is included in the design brief, although individual bay allocations require confirmation. Creek Island, Central Park and Creek Marina provide the wider setting; their parks, restaurants and leisure attractions should not be confused with facilities reserved for this building.
research.locationNote: Emaar locates the development near Creek Beach, with views towards Creek Island. Downtown Dubai, the airport and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary are surrounding destinations. Published travel times vary between the page and brochure, so check an actual route. References to metro connectivity do not establish that a nearby station is operational.
research.priceNote: The official page advertises AED 1.87m. The June 2024 launch sheet quotes one, two and three bedroom categories from AED 1.87m, 2.92m and 4.93m. These are historical launch figures, not confirmation of available units or today’s quotation.
research.paymentNote: The published launch schedule totals 90% before completion and 10% at completion. Construction-linked dates are estimates; obtain the current outstanding-payment schedule for the specific unit.
research.handoverNote: March 2029 is the estimated completion month in the payment document and Property Finder. It is subject to the current construction programme and purchase contract.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: The fact sheet describes a 50% one-bedroom, 40% two-bedroom and 10% three-bedroom mix. It does not provide a verified project-wide apartment count.

facts.label: Ground-floor outdoor space
facts.value: Ground unit 01 has 1,459.16 sq ft of suite area and 598.04 sq ft of balcony area. Its three-bedroom plan includes a maid’s room, laundry and powder room. Larger total area therefore does not mean the same increase in indoor living space.

facts.label: Availability and timing
facts.value: Property Finder shows a sold-out label alongside pricing and resale listings. Its construction update is dated November 2025. Neither the price nor that older progress figure confirms current developer inventory or present construction status.
